info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Telecom Sim Swap-v1-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Swap API facilitates the secure and efficient swapping of SIM cards for users, enabling seamless service continuity. This endpoint allows authorized service providers to initiate the SIM swap process, ensuring that customers can easily transition between SIMs without service interruptions. Typical consumers of this API include telecom operators and customer service platforms, which leverage this capability to enhance user experiences during SIM transitions. By utilizing this API, providers can ensure a smooth operation while maintaining the integrity of customer accounts.

post.summary: Initiate a SIM card swap process.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a SIM card swap for a user. A successful request will trigger the necessary workflows to update the user's SIM information and ensure uninterrupted service.

requestBody.description: Contains the necessary information to swap SIM cards within the application. This includes details such as the current SIM card information and the desired replacement SIM card attributes.

200.description: The swap operation was successfully completed.
